segments.name: Sales operations in the United States
segments.description: Sells dehydrated fruit and vegetable snacks and ingredients to U.S. retail, private-label and food-manufacturing customers.
segments.evidence: The Company has two components, consisting of its sales operations in the United States, and its production operations in Peru.

segments.name: Production operations in Peru
segments.description: Manufactures dehydrated fruit and vegetable products at the Peru Facility for export to the United States.
segments.evidence: The Company has two components, consisting of its sales operations in the United States, and its production operations in Peru.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid by large national retail customers (such as Costco and Walmart), private-label retailers and food manufacturers for its branded snacks, private-label products and industrial ingredients, generally under purchase orders and program-based arrangements.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our products primarily through large national retail customers in the United States, including Costco and Walmart, with additional limited sales through private-label and ingredient customers.
